Einleitung: the device is based on the Qualcomm Atheros AR9331 chipset and runs OpenWrt as default firmware

considering the features, the 6416 can be seen as an "improved" version of the TL-WR703N with more RAM and Flash, furthermore it has 2 ethernet ports like the TL-WR710N. Since fall 2015 the GL-AR150 is available as successor of the 6416

openwrt_git_ath79.titel: ath79: add support for GL.iNet 6408/6416 (GL.iNet V1)
openwrt_git_ath79.text: The GL-Connect GL.iNet v1 routers are basically a TP-Link TL-WR710N with more DRAM/Flash and console/GPIO header in the same small form-factor.
openwrt_git_ath79.Unterschied: The difference between 6408 and 6416 is just the flash size. It looks like only the 16 MiB version has been advertised, while the 6408 is a modified version. There are also 1-port versions sold by third parties.
openwrt_git_ath79.Installation: Install the sysupgrade image via stock firmware GUI or upload it via uboot (web-based). The device will be available at 192.168.1.1.
openwrt_git_ath79.Warnung: In ar71xx, the same board name is used for both flash versions. So, please make sure you flash the correct ath79 image when upgrading.
openwrt_git_ath79.Test: This has been device-tested on a GL.iNet 6416.
openwrt_git_ath79.01_leds: glinet,6408|glinet,6416: ucidef_set_led_netdev lan LAN gl-inet:green:lan eth0

openwrt_git_ar71xx.text: There are two versions of the GL.iNet, the 6408A and the 6416A. The only difference is the flash size.

glinet_produkt.Kurztext: Powered by Atheros AR9331 / Stable / Low cost / GPIO, UART
glinet_produkt.Beschreibung: GL.iNet 6416 is our first mini starter router designed for OpenWrt and DIY hobbyists. In hardware, it provides 5 GPIOs in 2.0mm distance, UART, 3.3V Power, 1 USB-A adapter, one Reset button. It is powered by any USB power adapter which can provide 5V 1A. In software, it comes with OpenWrt BB 1407 firmware.

glinet_docs.Text: GL-iNet6416 is our first generation mini router. It is welcomed by makers and hobbyists, widely used in IoT, home automation and wifi control projects. This model is discontinued and replaced by our most welcomed AR150 model.
